description:
A ticket's seat as a seller writes it ("Sec 129C Row 12", "Section
111, Row M, Seats 5-6", "100 Level 113 Row 4") read onto the venue's
seating chart: which section and row it is, where the section sits,
how far the row is from the field, court or stage, how high it sits,
whether it's covered, and a picture of the view. readAs shows how
the words were read. A row between the front and back is estimated
from them and marked "estimated". A name the chart doesn't know
comes back with found false, not a guess.

venue: the venue's name ("Madison Square Garden", "MetLife
Stadium").
seat: the seat as the listing gives it.

Covers the venues with an UPFRONT seating chart; for any other venue
the answer says so and lists the ones covered.
name: resolve_seat
title: Read a ticket's seat
